vcode.description:
Vcode: Code Anywhere. Build Anything.

Vcode is an Android code editor designed to make coding on your phone easier, more accessible, and more convenient. Whether you're writing your first program, developing a project, or experimenting with new ideas, Vcode brings your coding workspace right to your fingertips.

Built with mobile developers in mind, Vcode aims to simplify the coding experience without requiring a traditional desktop setup.

Key Features

- Mobile Coding: Write and edit code directly from your Android device.
- Developer-Focused: A coding workspace designed for developers on the go.
- Project Development: Work on your coding projects wherever inspiration strikes.
- Lightweight Workflow: Keep your development experience centered on your phone.
- Open Source: Explore the source code and follow development on GitHub.

Vcode is built for developers, students, and coding enthusiasts who want the freedom to create software wherever they are.

Your phone. Your code. Your next big idea.

Source code: https://github.com/Christianzz4603/Vcode
